verdict.rationale: Xero has a broad public API with an official OpenAPI spec, official SDKs (xero-node) and an official MCP server. The MCP server documents contacts, chart of accounts and invoice management, so core accounting data is clearly programmable. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matches the UI, and many UI features have no evidenced API equivalent, including JAX reconciliation, custom dashboards, industry benchmarking, invoice tracking and payment-file export. Machine-to-machine access also sits behind the premium Custom Connections option. Missing for 10: any documented claim or coverage map of UI/API parity, API evidence for bank reconciliation, reporting/dashboards and AI bill capture, and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.
